entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. The trial enrolled adults only; no paediatric exposure exists in this study.
entries.snippet: Eligible patients were age ≥ 18 years or older

entries.proposition: Median age and range of the cohort (adults, oldest 84; youngest 22).
entries.snippet: The median age for the cohort was 75 years (22–84 years).

entries.proposition: The recommended phase 2 dose was set at the 21 mg level after hepatic DLTs at 42 mg; the 42 mg level was stopped for liver-injury risk.
entries.snippet: Due to the potential for serious drug-induced liver injury, the 42 mg dose level was discontinued, even though the criteria for the MTD were not met.

entries.proposition: One DLT at 42 mg was grade 3 hepatic failure meeting Hy law criteria together with encephalopathy; both resolved within two weeks of stopping (adult haematology cohort).
entries.snippet: Another patient experienced encephalopathy and grade 3 hepatic failure with AST, ALT, and bilirubin elevations meeting criteria for Hy’s law at the 42 mg dose.

entries.proposition: Six deaths without overt progression included an intracranial haemorrhage; no attribution to the drug is stated in the text.
entries.snippet: Six deaths occurred in the absence of overt disease progression due to lung infection, cardiac arrest, intracranial hemorrhage, fungal infection, and septic shock.

entries.proposition: The paper states the transaminase toxicity "appeared dose-dependent" by contrasting the 21 and 42 mg levels with lower ones; no per-dose tabulation of the 7 events is given, and the same paragraph reports 1 of 15 at the 21 mg RP2D, which is one of the two levels the claim names as highest-incidence.
entries.snippet: Any grade treatment-related transaminase toxicity was observed in 7 patients and appeared dose-dependent, occurring more frequently at the highest 21 mg and 42 mg dose levels. At the RP2D, only 1 out of 15 patients had transaminase elevation.

entries.proposition: PK claim: plasma PK described as dose-proportional from 1 to 42 mg; mean half-life 28 h.
entries.snippet: Plasma PK of BTX A51 was dose-proportional between 1 and 42 mg with accumulation based on AUC between Day 1 and Day 5.

entries.proposition: Pharmacodynamics were measured on CD34-positive marrow cells of three patients only, at the 21 and 42 mg levels.
entries.snippet: Immunocytochemistry studies were performed on CD34 + cells isolated from bone marrow aspirates collected from 3 patients treated at the 21 mg and 42 mg levels, including a responder (Fig. 2).

entries.proposition: Serum MIC-1 (p53 surrogate) was evaluated in 8 patients and described as variable at day 2 and elevated at day 5.
entries.snippet: The serum MIC-onefold change from baseline was variable on day 2 and remained elevated on day 5.

entries.proposition: The cell-line claim: MYC and MDM2 fall after 100 nM A51 for 24 h in five AML lines (a leukaemia system, not neural).
entries.snippet: This resulted in a marked decrease in the expression of oncogenes such as MYC and MDM2.

entries.proposition: The statement that A51 reduced CTD phosphorylation in all five lines, including HL-60.
entries.snippet: A51 treatment induced a significant reduction in Pol II CTD phosphorylation at Ser2 or Ser5 in RUNX1 mutant (OCI AML-5) and RUNX1 WT (MV4-11, THP-1, OCI AML-3, and HL-60) AML cell lines (Fig. 4).

entries.proposition: The IC50 comparison RUNX1-mutant versus NRAS/IDH2-mutant blasts carries a p-value in the text.
entries.snippet: Further, RUNX1-mutated CD34 + primary AML blasts cocultured with HUVEC-AD52 were more sensitive to BTX A51 than NRAS and IDH2 mutated CD34 + primary AML blasts (IC50 19 nM vs. 38 nM, p < 0.01, Fig. 5B-C).

entries.proposition: Statement that the 21 mg dose may suffice for maximum biological effect because no MIC-1 or immunostaining difference between 21 and 42 mg was seen.
entries.snippet: Therefore, the 21 mg dose may be sufficient to achieve maximum biological effects.

entries.proposition: Responses were found only in RUNX1-mutated patients, at 11 or 21 mg; none at 42 mg (n = 5).
entries.snippet: We did not observe any responses among the five patients treated at the 42 mg dose.

entries.proposition: The sponsor funded the study and analysed the data.
entries.snippet: The study sponsor analyzed the data and conducted statistical analyses.
